NONE: › to fight or argue with people
打架；爭吵

example: Don't take any notice of Sally - she just likes to mix it.

NONE: › to confuse, worry, or upset someone
使（某人）不知所措；把（某人）搞糊塗

example: The directions he gave me mixed me up and I went the wrong way.
他給我指的路把我搞糊塗了，結果我走錯了路。

NONE: B2 to fail to recognize two people or things correctly by thinking that one person or thing is the other person or thing
混淆；把…弄錯

example: People often mix us up because we look so similar.
人們常常把我們弄錯，因為我們看起來很相像。
I think you're mixing me up with my sister.
我想你把我和我姐姐弄錯了。

NONE: › to make a group of things untidy or badly organized, or to move them into the wrong order
弄錯，弄亂

example: Don't mix up the bottles - you'll have to repeat the experiment if you do.
別弄亂那些瓶子——如果亂了，你就要重做這個實驗。
Your jigsaw puzzles and games are all mixed up together in that box.
你的拼圖玩具和遊戲用具都亂糟糟地混在那個盒子裡。

NONE: › to combine two or more metaphors, often producing a silly or humorous effect
（常產生愚蠢、滑稽效果的）混合隱喻

example: Mixing his metaphors, he described the problem by saying "We've opened up a can of worms here, and now we have to get the genie back in the bottle".
他用混合隱喻形容面對的問題：「我們打開了一個『蟲罐子』，現在我們必須把精靈放回瓶裡去。」

NONE: › a mistake that causes confusion

example: There was a mix-up at the office and we all received the wrong forms.
辦公室搞錯了，我們都收到了錯誤的表格。

NONE: › showing a mixture of different feelings or opinions
（感覺或觀點）不統一的，褒貶混雜的
› including many different types of people or things
（不同的人或物）混合的；混雜的

男女混合的
› including people of different religions or races
不同宗教（或種族）混合的

example: There has been a mixed reaction to the changes.

結果比我們所期待的稍為混雜。

她的朋友裡有各種各樣的人。

我們的孩子都唸男女校。

在有男有女的場合下，他的一些笑話就顯得太粗俗了。

異族通婚

NONE: › a range of different things or people
（人或物的）混合體，大雜燴

example: There's a real mixed bag of people taking the class.
修這門課的甚麼人都有。

NONE: › something that has advantages and disadvantages
福禍參半的事物，利弊並存的事物

example: Getting into the team is a mixed blessing - I'll have to spend a lot of time training.
加入這支球隊有好處也有壞處——我得花許多時間訓練。

NONE: › a game, for example a tennis game, in which each team consists of one female and one male player
（網球等的）混合雙打

混合經濟
› a method of farming in which crops are grown and animals are kept on the same farm
（耕作與牲畜飼養相結合的）混合農業
› If you have mixed feelings about something, you feel both pleased and not pleased about it at the same time.
互相矛盾的感情，喜憂參半

example: I had mixed feelings about leaving home. I was excited but at the same time, I knew I would miss my family.
對於離家我的感情很矛盾。很興奮，但與此同時，我知道我會想家。

NONE: › a combination of a whole number and a fraction
帶分數

烤雜排
› different methods for producing art
（藝術創作的）混合媒體
› different methods for advertising products and services, such as newspapers, TV, radio, and the internet
（廣告的）綜合媒體

example: Modern art has encouraged the use of mixed media.
現代藝術鼓勵對混合媒體的使用。

使用綜合媒體的廣告專案

NONE: › a combination of two or more different metaphors, often producing a silly or humorous effect
（常產生愚蠢、滑稽效果的）混合隱喻

example: "The new job has allowed her to spread her wings and really blossom," is a mixed metaphor.
「新工作使她能展開翅膀、真正綻放」是一個混合隱喻。

NONE: › upset, worried, and confused, especially because of personal problems

NONE: › involving students of different levels of ability

涉及不同種族人的
